# The Wandering Bar

> Upscale mobile bar service based in the Shuswap/Kamloops area of Interior BC, Canada. Custom cocktails, mocktails, specialty coffee, and curated beverage experiences for weddings, private events, and celebrations.

The Wandering Bar operates vintage horse-trailer-converted mobile bars, staffed with professional bartenders, serving weddings and private events across Kamloops, Shuswap, Okanagan, and the BC Interior. Rated 5.0 stars on Google Reviews.

## Services

- [Packages & Pricing](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#packages): Mobile bar service packages for weddings and events
- [Gallery](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#gallery): Photos of past events and trailer setups
- [Dry Hire](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#dry-hire): Bar trailer rental without bartending staff
- [FAQ](https://www.thewanderingbarshuswap.com/#faq): Common questions about booking, pricing, and service area

## Packages & Pricing

- **The Elevated** — from $1,200+. 4 hours of service. Custom drink menu (cocktails or mocktails), premium mixers & garnishes, styled bar setup, menu signage. Best for weddings, engagement parties & corporate events.
- **The Signature** (most popular) — from $1,500+. 6 hours of service. Full custom beverage experience, 2 signature cocktails/mocktails/specialty drinks, luxury bar styling, premium ingredients, coffee or add-on station option, personalized consultation. Best for luxury weddings, large events & high-end celebrations.
- **Bespoke** — custom quote. Fully tailored: flexible service hours, any combination of experiences, additional staff as needed. Best for unique events & large gatherings.
- **Add-ons**: Specialty Coffee Bar (+$250–$600), Dirty Soda Bar (+$500–$700), Custom Mocktail Upgrade (+$2.25/person), Extra Bartender (+$100/hour).
- Alcohol is not provided by The Wandering Bar — clients purchase their own alcohol per Canadian liquor law; a recommended shopping list is provided. Pricing varies by guest count and venue. A deposit is required to secure a date. Travel fees vary by location.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Do you provide alcohol?** No. The client purchases alcohol; The Wandering Bar provides a recommended shopping list based on guest count and menu. This follows Canadian liquor law, which prohibits mobile services from selling alcohol.
- **Are you licensed and insured?** Yes, business insurance is carried and operations comply with applicable event requirements; specific licensing can vary by venue and event type.
- **What events do you cater to?** Weddings, engagement parties, bridal showers, corporate events, private parties, birthdays, holiday events, markets, and other celebrations.
- **Do you offer non-alcoholic options?** Yes — elevated mocktails, specialty coffee, dirty sodas, hot chocolate bars, and fully customized alcohol-free experiences.
- **Can the drink menu be customized?** Yes, every menu is curated with the client to match event style and preferences.
- **Where do you travel?** Kamloops, Shuswap, Okanagan, and the BC Interior; travel fees may apply by location.
- **How far in advance should we book?** As early as possible, especially for weddings and peak season — dates fill quickly.
- **Is a deposit required?** Yes, a retainer secures the date, with the balance due before the event.
- **Can large events be accommodated?** Yes, from intimate gatherings to large celebrations.
- **How do you book?** Submit an inquiry through the contact form on the website.
